name: Crystals, Gems and Jewels: Topaz Surge

system.description:
Crystal Weapon Dance. When you score a critical hit with your Crystal Weapon, you regain 4 Hardness. Beginning at 7th level, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature under the effect of a Jutsu you cast with the Earth release keyword, you regain 2 Hardness. Beginning at 15th level, you can regain 1 Hardness each time you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature with an Elemental condition.

Crystal Aura. When an allied creature other than yourself scores a critical hit, you regain 4 Hardness. Beginning at 7th level, once per turn, when an allied creature other than yourself begins their turn and maintains concentration on a jutsu they cast, you regain 2 Hardness. Beginning at 15th level, once per turn, when an allied creature other than yourself casts a jutsu while in your radius, you regain 1 Hardness.
